title: Ex-servicemen, families stage protest in Keralam’s Kannur demanding better ECHS facilities

ai.summary: Ex-servicemen and families in Kannur staged a protest demanding better ECHS medical facilities and urgent government intervention for healthcare access.

facts.claim: Ex-servicemen and their family members staged a protest march and dharna in Kannur on Thursday
facts.quote: Several ex-servicemen and their family members staged a protest march and dharna in Kannur on Thursday demanding better medical facilities under the Ex-Servicemen Contributory Health Scheme (ECHS) and the urgent intervention of the Central government to address the healthcare crisis faced by former defence personnel and their dependents.

facts.claim: The protest was organised by the Kannur district committee of the Kerala State Ex-Servicemen’s League
facts.quote: The protest was organised by the Kannur district committee of the Kerala State Ex-Servicemen’s League, highlighting the shortage of ECHS empanelled super-specialty hospitals in the district.

facts.claim: Thousands of ex-servicemen and their family members were facing serious difficulties in accessing quality medical treatment due to the inadequate number of empanelled hospitals
facts.quote: The organisation said thousands of ex-servicemen and their family members were facing serious difficulties in accessing quality medical treatment due to the inadequate number of empanelled hospitals.

facts.claim: The protest march began at 10 a.m. from the DSC Record office circle
facts.quote: The protest march began at 10 a.m. from the DSC Record office circle and was flagged off by league president Col. Jayadevan.

facts.claim: The subsequent dharna in front of the Kannur head post office was inaugurated by T.O. Mohan, MLA
facts.quote: The subsequent dharna in front of the Kannur head post office was inaugurated by T.O. Mohan, MLA.

facts.claim: The committee’s demands included ensuring prompt disbursement of medical treatment bills to empanelled hospitals
facts.quote: The committee’s demands included ensuring prompt disbursement of medical treatment bills to empanelled hospitals.

facts.claim: The organisation also sought to establish an ECHS polyclinic at Alakode, Taliparamba, and Thalassery
facts.quote: The organisation also sought to establish an ECHS polyclinic at Alakode, Taliparamba, and Thalassery.

ai.background_note: The protest is part of the ongoing ECHS healthcare crisis for ex-servicemen in Kerala, with the Kerala State Ex-Servicemen’s League demanding improved medical infrastructure and government intervention.
